issues.detail: The Greek 'μη γενοιτο' is ajussive/optative construction expressing 'let it not be' or 'may it never be', used here as a rhetorical device to say 'it should not be so'. The Vietnamese translation 'Chẳng hề như vậy!' (Not at all!) interprets this as a flat negation of a statement, whereas the Greek is a rhetorical question about the possibility of injustice occurring from God.
